description: This file contains extension methods for the ContentItem class in the OrchardCore.ContentManagement namespace, providing functionalities such as retrieving, adding, removing, merging, and cloning content parts and items.

classes.name: ContentItemExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ContentItem to manage content parts and properties.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a content part by its type or name, returning true if found.

methods.name: As
methods.description: Retrieves a content part by its type, or null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: GetOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a content part by its type or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a content part by its type.

methods.name: Weld
methods.description: Adds or welds a content part to a content item.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Updates or applies a content part to a content item.

methods.name: Alter
methods.description: Modifies a content part with a provided action.

methods.name: AlterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously modifies a content part with a provided async action.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges properties into a content item, updating its data and removing well-known properties.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates an in-memory clone of a content item.
